dataTerms.Field: (a) Retention of API inputs and outputs
dataTerms.Content: “We do not retain prompt or response content after the response is returned, and we do not use API content to train models.” Prompt-prefix cache: “Cached entries are automatically evicted over time – typically within minutes and generally within a few hours – and do not survive a restart of the secure enclave.”

Privacy: as in (a). FAQ: “No. Inference enclaves never write prompts or responses to disk, and plaintext content does not leave the enclave at any point, so it cannot be used for training, fine-tuning, evaluation, or service improvement even if we wanted to.” DPA: “Note that the Processor does not use any AI input or output data (including Company Personal Data) to fine tune, train or develop its AI functionality or models for its own purposes nor does the Processor allow any third parties (including its Subprocessors) to do this”

“operational logs never include prompts or completions.” Terms: “The Services are designed so we do not have access to plaintext prompts, responses, or in-enclave workload contents processed through confidential computing.”

Privacy: “Inference API: prompts and responses are processed inside secure enclaves designed to keep content inaccessible to Tinfoil, our cloud providers, and other third parties during normal operation.” Docs: “User request data is processed inside secure enclaves that even Tinfoil cannot access, giving you hardware-enforced privacy that is verifiable via remote attestation.” Docs note: “V3 attestation and features that depend on it are **beta** while deployment is ongoing.”
